title: ball_squeeze_2025
description: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) dataset named ball_squeeze_2025, in BIDS format with SNIRF recordings (68 files, approximately 5.42 GB). The dataset title suggests a ball-squeezing motor task, but the source README does not describe the experimental paradigm, participants, or acquisition parameters. The BIDS metadata lists Boston University IRB approval 4502. The dataset is mirrored on NEMAR from OpenNeuro (ds006903).
